verdict.rationale: Morph documents building with standard SDKs: point any OpenAI SDK at its `/v1` endpoint, and the Anthropic Messages API is served natively, so existing OpenAI and Anthropic client code works with a model-string change. Its docs also sit under an `/sdk/components` section covering Fast Apply, Compact, Reflexes, Standby and Caching. However, the evidence never shows a Morph-branded, first-party SDK package (install name, languages, typed clients), so SDK building relies on third-party provider SDKs rather than official Morph SDKs. Missing for 10: a documented first-party Morph SDK package with install instructions, multi-language coverage, an OpenAPI spec for generated clients (probes 404), and independent hands-on corroboration of SDK use.
